args.message: Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, which broke the nightly build since `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212.

## Change
- Switch rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` passed (tests including `test_half_even`).
args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix FIN-212: use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money
